0.literal: He picked up what I threw away... from the trash can in the park.
0.official: He musta picked it up after I threw it out. Pulled it from the park trash can.

1.literal: The Hogushi Kaikan uniform I took from you...
1.official: The Hogushi Kaikan uniform I got from you...

2.literal: ...and the photos of the woman I was going to use as a stand-in.
2.official: and the photos of the girl.

3.literal: ...The guy on the phone is someone else entirely.

4.literal: But he knew that I'd been ordered to kill Makoto...
4.official: Though from the way he talked, he knew I'd been ordered to kill Makoto.

5.literal: So he should know why she's being targeted from all sides.
5.official: Besides, he's gotta know the reason why everybody's after her.

6.literal: It's about time I settled this.
6.official: I'm way past ready to get that nailed down.

7.literal: Damn, they were lying in wait for me...

8.literal: Where is Lee-san!? I have urgent business with Lee-san!
8.official: Where Lee-san now!? I must see Lee-san right away!

9.literal: I want to deliver his medicine. Lee-san's painkillers are running out.
9.official: He need drugs. Lee-san run out of painkiller soon.

10.literal: Thank you for everything that time.
10.official: The last couple times have been a real pleasure...

11.literal: Yes... I believe the boss gave you a call a little while ago.
11.official: Yes. I believe you received a phone call from him?

12.official: And the gift of Makoto Makimura's dead body.

13.literal: I'm gonna get a good look at that face of his...!

14.literal: ...Anyway, it sure was noisy down there, huh?
14.official: Pretty wild scene down there on the floor, eh?

15.literal: Leaving her floating in Sotenbori — that's pretty flashy of you.
15.official: Leaving her floating down Sotenbori, now that was a bold move.

16.literal: It slipped my mind. I was just about to get in touch.
16.official: Look, I forgot. Till just now--I came up here to call you.

17.literal: Something about this just doesn't sit right with me.
17.official: I just can't figure it out.

18.literal: Say... why'd you go to the trouble of smashing the body's face?
18.official: Why go through the trouble of smashing her face in?

19.literal: Do you want to hide the body's identity or not?
19.official: Can't tell if you're trying to hide who she is or broadcast it.

20.literal: You say you were shaken up?

21.literal: Believe it or not, he's just like me... a direct member of the Omi Alliance.
21.official: You wouldn't know it to look at him, but he's Omi Alliance brass, same as me.

23.literal: They do whatever they please, no matter whose turf it is.
23.official: They'll roll in on anybody's turf and do whatever they like.

24.literal: They're what you'd call Sotenbori's troublemakers.

25.literal: Why have they been messing with you?
25.official: Why's the Kijin Clan throwing down in your club?

26.literal: Maybe he just wasn't used to drinking the good stuff?
26.official: Maybe the guy wasn't used to drinkin' the good stuff.

27.literal: There's no way you could keep secrets from me.
27.official: But you're right, there's no way you could keep something from me.

28.literal: After all, you know firsthand what would happen if you did.
28.official: ...Because you've still got the scars to remind you what would happen to you if you did.

29.literal: Ahh... I can't get enough of this...

30.literal: ...You're one tough bastard to put down.
30.official: How are you even still talkin'?

35.literal: What about the customer who reserved the place...?
35.official: That was the customer who rented the club out, is he...?

36.literal: ...Never mind that, you just handle the cops.
36.official: ...You just deal with the police, would ya?

37.literal: Have the others get ready to open. We're back to regular business as of now.
37.official: And tell the others to get ready to open. We're back to regular business.

38.literal: U-Understood. We'll open the club as soon as we're ready.
38.official: U-Understood, sir. We'll have the doors open as soon as we're ready.

39.literal: But they said you were too much for them to handle...
39.official: But they came back sayin' you were too hot to handle.

40.literal: So you're the head of those numbskulls.
40.official: You're the one leadin' that idiot parade?

41.literal: Now, don't get all worked up — just hear me out.
41.official: No call for gettin' snotty, now. Hear me out.

42.literal: That idiot will never find out the body is someone else.
42.official: That braindead chimpanzee ain't gonna figure out the body's a fake.

43.literal: There's no settling this down now, is there!?

44.literal: He's pulled a knife in my club!
44.official: I got this whack job of a yakuza in here right now wavin' a big ol' knife around!

45.literal: I'm a genuine robber, certified by the cops, y'know?
45.official: I'm a bona fide robber! Just ask the cops...

46.literal: This ain't about work for me anymore. I'm gonna enjoy myself, y'hear?
46.official: This ain't even about work anymore. Let's have some fun!

47.official: Don't go lettin' me down, now!

48.literal: ...Money over the bond between fellow Chinese, huh...

49.literal: Leave him be. He's the man who betrayed you.
49.official: Leave him already. He betrayed you.

50.literal: Just staying shut away in here the whole time, being protected...
50.official: Staying shut in here while you two put yourselves in danger for me is... I can't.

51.literal: The guy on the phone I mentioned was their boss,
51.official: The guy on the phone was their boss.

52.literal: A man named Nishitani. He leads a clan called the Kijin Clan.
52.official: Went by Nishitani. He runs an outfit called the Kijin Clan.

53.literal: He's probably figured out... that I just let this girl slip away without lifting a finger.
53.official: I'm pretty sure he's wise to the fact I didn't kill his girl.

54.literal: How long is this girl gonna have to live in fear?
54.official: She gonna have to live the rest of her life waitin' for a bullet?

55.literal: I'm... a prisoner of this town.

56.literal: I'm the robber who broke into this place!
56.official: I'm the big, bad robber who busted in on this place!

57.literal: He's a robber! Please hurry and come help!!
57.official: He's a robber! Get down here quick, okay!?

59.literal: So he used that to disguise the body as Makoto's?
59.official: So then he takes that, whacks the girl, and plays Makoto dress-up with the body?

60.literal: ...If he keeps sniffing around any longer, he'll just be an eyesore.
60.official: Better than having him sneakin' around me.

61.literal: ...If he keeps sniffing around any longer, he'll just be an eyesore.
61.official: Better than having him sneakin' around me.

62.literal: And yet you left the body dressed in the clothes from the woman's workplace.
62.official: And then you turn around and leave her in her uniform?

63.literal: And yet you left the body dressed in the clothes from the woman's workplace.
63.official: And then you turn around and leave her in her uniform?

64.literal: The Kijin Clan are mavericks who don't team up with anyone.
64.official: Omi's got all kinds, but even by that standard, the Kijin Clan are loose cannons. Not exactly team players.

65.literal: The Kijin Clan are mavericks who don't team up with anyone.
65.official: Omi's got all kinds, but even by that standard, the Kijin Clan are loose cannons. Not exactly team players.

66.literal: I won't reveal the secret to anyone. I'll take it to my grave.
66.official: that secret stays with me. I'll carry it to the grave.

67.literal: I won't reveal the secret to anyone. I'll take it to my grave.
67.official: that secret stays with me. I'll carry it to the grave.

68.literal: Trace it back far enough, and it's all the same Omi Alliance.
68.official: Nishitani's part of the same group as the guy who hired me, Sagawa. The Omi Alliance.

69.literal: Trace it back far enough, and it's all the same Omi Alliance.
69.official: Nishitani's part of the same group as the guy who hired me, Sagawa. The Omi Alliance.
